$comment: Local Doc Index sweep configuration. Copy to config.json next to sweep.mjs (git-ignored) and fill in. Secrets belong in environment variables via {"$env": "NAME"} — never commit them.

paths.$comment: OneDrive-synced local roots. sourceLibrary = the LocationReferencing Documents library; sidecarLibrary = the LRS Doc Index library (sidecars + media/).

graph.$comment: auth 'device' (default): NO Azure app registration — the first run prints a device-code sign-in (you sign in as yourself; your existing SharePoint permissions apply) and caches refresh tokens under paths.workDir/auth/. If the tenant blocks the scope on first sign-in, set clientId to a pre-consented public client (Azure CLI: 04b07795-8ddb-461a-bbee-02f9e1bf7b46). auth 'interactive': same delegated sign-in, but via the authorization-code grant over a loopback redirect instead of a device code — use it when Conditional Access rejects device-code with AADSTS53003 ('does not meet the criteria to access this resource'), which it does on a joined machine because the device-code browser carries no device identity. Everything after the first sign-in is identical. App-registration alternative: {"auth": "app", "tenantId": "...", "clientId": "...", "clientSecret": {"$env": "DOCINDEX_GRAPH_SECRET"}} — Local_Setup.md §2.

llm.$comment: provider 'aibuilder' calls the SAME AI Builder custom prompt the cloud flow uses — same model, same tenant-hosted prompt text, same AI Builder credit metering — via the Dataverse Web API. Auth follows the graph section above (default: device sign-in as you — you own the prompt, so no extra grant is needed; Local_Setup.md §3). environmentUrl = the environment's Dataverse URL; modelId = the flow's Run_prompt recordId. Alternative: "provider": "anthropic" (Claude-account OAuth via `ant auth login`, or auth 'apiKey') executes prompts/DocIndex_Prompt.md instead — see local/CHANGES.md v1.1.
llm.testPlanModelId: <run: testplangen.mjs --models — the 'LRS Test Plan Generation' GUID; only for provider 'aibuilder' (the tenant prompt must carry all five parameters + the current text — Coverage_Runbook.md step 2); provider 'anthropic' executes prompts/TestPlanGen_Prompt.md verbatim and needs no tenant prompt>

alerts.$comment: Optional push alerting (v1.32). webhookUrl = a Teams/Slack incoming-webhook URL (accepts {"$env": "NAME"}); the sweep posts {"text": ...} on a fatal abort and for docs stuck 3+ nights, and `sweep.mjs --check-heartbeat` (schedule local\run_heartbeat.cmd as a second task) alerts when no successful live sweep is recorded within maxSilentHours. Absent section = alerts off.

curation.$comment: Weekly keyword curation (local/curate.mjs — Local_Setup.md §9). Optional; these are the defaults, mirroring the KeywordCuration flow's Config_cur. autoApprove: true applies guard-passing merges immediately (digest becomes an audit log; undo = clear CanonicalRef + set CurationStatus Rejected).

testplangen.$comment: On-demand test-plan generation (local/testplangen.mjs — Local_Setup.md §11). Optional; these are the defaults, mirroring the TestPlanGenCore flow's Config_gen name-for-name. promptVersion is the draft-banner stamp (TestPlanGenPromptVersion — NEVER Config.PromptVersion); draftFolder is drive-root-relative (the site default drive root = Shared Documents); verify is the draft-verifier policy: 'annotate' flags findings in the written draft, 'strict' refuses to write a draft with findings, 'off' = cloud-flow parity; grounding false disables just the heuristic story-grounding layer (the contract lint stays); notify true posts one webhook line per WRITTEN draft to alerts.webhookUrl (also per-run via --notify); provider '' follows llm.provider, or set 'anthropic'/'aibuilder' to override the transport for GENERATION ONLY (e.g. drafts on the Anthropic lane while the sweep's classify step stays on AI Builder); maxTokens bounds the anthropic lane's reply (a truncated draft fails closed). The auto knobs gate `--auto` (unattended gap-drafting after the nightly sweep, schedule local\run_testplangen.cmd): autoDraft is the owner switch — the scheduled task is INERT until it is true; autoMaxPerRun caps model calls per night; autoLookbackDays bounds which freshly indexed stories are candidates.

sweep.$comment: Mirrors flow v2.8 Config. Values below are the v2.8 defaults; keep them in sync with STATUS when the flow config changes. Also available: graphDownloadFallback (true = a source file missing from the OneDrive-synced folder is fetched through Graph instead of erroring for the night, v1.33); exportLists (false disables the per-run gzip list backup in workDir, v1.32); indexPages (false disables the _Index.md browse pages, v1.35); tesseractPath + pdftoppmPath + ocrMaxPages (set tesseractPath to enable the OCR lane for image-only PDFs, v1.36); embedRelated + embedSimMin with llm.embeddings {baseUrl, apiKey, model} (embedding-assisted relatedness via a Voyage/OpenAI-compatible endpoint — document text leaves the tenant when on, v1.38); remoteFiles + remoteDriveName (run with NO OneDrive: sidecars mirror down and write through Graph, sources download on demand — local/Hosted_Runner.md, v1.39).
